questions.cardText:
[Physiology and Anatomy] Why do hair and nails appear longer after death?
A. They continue to grow after death
B. They harden and extend
C. It is because of the retraction of the skin
Answer: C. Hair and nails do not continue to grow after death. After death, the body dehydrates, causing the skin to retract. This retraction exposes more of the hair and nails, creating the illusion that they have grown longer.
questions.de: Warum scheinen Haare und Nägel nach dem Tod länger zu werden, obwohl sie nicht weiterwachsen?
questions.en: Why do hair and nails seem to get longer after death, although they do not keep growing?
questions.answerDe: Die Haut trocknet aus und zieht sich zurück

timeline.labelEn: The BMJ's 'Medical myths' paper debunks the belief that hair and nails keep growing after death
timeline.labelDe: Der BMJ-Artikel „Medical myths“ widerlegt den Glauben, Haare und Nägel wüchsen nach dem Tod weiter

questions.cardText:
[Philosophy] Who is the philosopher known for his theory of the “categorical imperative” and his work on ethics?
A. Friedrich Nietzsche
B. John Locke
C. Immanuel Kant
Answer: C.
questions.de: Welcher Philosoph ist für seine Theorie des „kategorischen Imperativs“ und seine Arbeiten zur Ethik bekannt?
questions.en: Which philosopher is known for his theory of the “categorical imperative” and his work on ethics?

timeline.labelEn: Kant publishes the Groundwork of the Metaphysics of Morals, which introduces the categorical imperative
timeline.labelDe: Kant veröffentlicht die „Grundlegung zur Metaphysik der Sitten“, die den kategorischen Imperativ einführt

source.title: Groundwork of the Metaphysics of Morals
